releaseGate.checks: Fresh remote exact SHA, complete clean tree, build SHA, artifact digest and exclusive release lock before upload

deploymentDiagnostic.firstAttempt: Stopped before upload because CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN was not exported; not a successful release
deploymentDiagnostic.recovery: Load existing token from .dev.vars only in child environment; reacquire release lock and rerun exported release gates; upload unchanged verified artifact with normal Wrangler
deploymentDiagnostic.exclusions: No second build, new credential/login/scope, release-tool edit, test-runner bypass or token printed
deploymentDiagnostic.completed: Wrangler uploaded/deployed and reported exact platform version; resume-upload-command-completed observed

cleanup: No service, account, upload or test asset created; temporary source/SSR/HTTP evidence retained
formalControl: Historical JRN-04-FIX RELEASE_READY untouched; this evidence index does not fabricate a formal CLOSED transition
nextAction: Archive evidence/documentation and push once, no redeployment. Existing read-only GSC observation is automatic subject to session/export; all further development requires authorization.
